equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 reported FCF -8,689m (Q1 -7,388m, Q2 -1,301m; LI_Quarterly_Q2-2026.txt:574); owner basis about -9.9bn. Added back at PV and trimmed so base-case implied H2 2026 owner flow is about -1.2bn.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment (base-case FY2027-FY2031 average); no historical CAGR is usable
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical CAGRs are not a usable anchor. Revenue CAGRs (35% 3yr, 64% 5yr) are the start-up ramp from FY2020-FY2022 and mask a -22% year in FY2025 and a further ~-6.5% in FY2026. Equity CAGRs (17-20%) were driven mainly by equity raises (2020 IPO, 2021 HK listing, ATM programs) and the FY2023-FY2024 profits, not by a repeatable return on equity, and equity has fallen from RMB73.1bn to RMB66.0bn in H1 2026. EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative start or end points).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income, applied to every year: FY2023 44,186 - 2,379 - 2,083 = 39,725; FY2024 8,203 - 2,631 - 1,820 = 3,752; FY2025 -12,817 - 1,258 - 1,919 = -15,994. The FY2023 figure is dominated by a RMB31.8bn increase in trade and notes payable and is not an earnings-power number; FY2025 includes a RMB13.0bn payables unwind.

scenario_narratives.base: A sub-scale recovery, not a return to the peak. The 2026 product cycle (all-new L9/L8/L6, refreshed i6, i9 launch) stabilises volumes - Q3 2026 was the first quarter of year-on-year delivery growth - and revenue grows 10% in FY2027, decelerating to 3%, regaining the FY2024 level only around FY2030. The price war eases through consolidation but never ends: gross margin recovers from the 8-11% of H1 2026 toward the high teens, and GAAP operating margin matures at ~3%, half the FY2023 peak. EREV remains the franchise; BEVs fill out the range without ever matching EREV economics. Roughly three quarters of this scenario's equity value is the net cash already on the balance sheet.
scenario_narratives.bull: The BEV pivot works and Li Auto is one of the 5-7 consolidated survivors. The i-series and the refreshed L-series lift volumes past the 2024 record of 500,000 by FY2028, overseas (Middle East, Central Asia, eventually Europe) adds a second leg, and in-house software/chips (MindVLA, MACH M100) hold pricing in the RMB200,000+ segment. Revenue compounds to ~RMB225bn and GAAP operating margin returns to 5.5%, the FY2023-FY2024 average. Requires several independent things to go right - BEV demand, industry discipline, overseas approvals - hence the reduced weight.
scenario_narratives.bear: The EREV category is commoditised by BYD, Huawei-backed brands, Xiaomi and Leapmotor before the BEV range earns its keep. Deliveries fall for two more years, revenue troughs near RMB78bn, gross margin stays in the low teens and the business never regains GAAP operating profit. Shrinkage runs off the supplier float (payables RMB38.8bn fund about half the cash pile), consuming on the order of RMB25-30bn of cash before the burn stops. Terminal owner FCF is about zero, so value is the remaining cash. This scenario does not model a VIE or delisting event - that tail sits in the bear weight.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Li Auto is valued as a cash-rich, currently loss-making cyclical automaker. At the current price the market capitalisation is roughly equal to net cash, i.e. the market assigns the operating business about zero value. The model agrees the operations are worth little today (base-case enterprise value is a minor share of equity) and the valuation is therefore mostly a judgment about how much of the RMB86bn cash pile survives the price war and belongs to ADS holders. FY2023 peak earnings are explicitly not extrapolated; the base case matures at half the peak operating margin.
key_risks_to_valuation: The cash is partly supplier float: trade and notes payable of RMB38.8bn (~150 days of cost of sales) fund about half of the cash position. Chinese automakers, Li Auto included, publicly committed in mid-2025 to ~60-day supplier payment terms (from the analyst's general knowledge, not verified in the filings on hand); full compliance would be a one-off outflow on the order of RMB20bn+, or roughly US$3 per ADS, which the base case does not include. Payables fell only RMB1.8bn in H1 2026.
Cash burn: reported FCF was -RMB12.8bn in FY2025 and -RMB8.7bn in H1 2026. Every further year at H1 2026 margins costs roughly US$1.5 per ADS.

VIE structure, PRC capital controls and HFCAA: ADS holders own a Cayman holding company; cash sits onshore. No scenario models impairment of access to it. The screener's China markdown is applied downstream, not here.

Year-1 treatment: FY2026 is the first projection year but H1 is already in the balance sheet; an equity-bridge add-back of RMB7.15bn (about US$1.07 per ADS) corrects the overlap. Q3 2026 results on 2026-11-25 replace this estimate with actuals.
Share count excludes 108.6m CEO Award Shares (release premium US$29.26 per ADS-equivalent) - dilutive only far above every scenario value here.
FX: all value is CNY; a 5% move in USD/CNY moves the USD value per ADS by 5%.

realisation_haircut.basis: seeded from the screener PRC markdown, 2026-11-19

inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-equivalent, fully diluted (1 ADS = 2 Class A ordinary shares). 2,027.7m ordinary shares outstanding at 2025-12-31 (1,671.9m Class A + 355.8m Class B, FY2025 20-F balance sheet; excludes 27.0m depositary bulk-issuance shares) less 91.7m repurchased to 2026-08-26 (Q2 2026 release) plus 58.9m employee awards outstanding at ~US$0.10 exercise price (41.9m + 17.0m, 20-F at 2026-02-28) = 1,994.9m ordinary = 997.4m ADS. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. EXCLUDED: 108.6m CEO Award Shares (release premium US$14.63/share = US$29.26/ADS, far out of the money) and 10.3m shares under the residual US$145.7m 2028 convertible (conversion US$28.34/ADS; carried as debt instead).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash flow statement add-back (LI_Annual_FY2025.txt:7219), RMB1,257.754m; ties to the non-GAAP reconciliation. No separate equity-award withholding-tax outflow disclosed (awards settle by share issuance / depositary bulk shares), so no combined figure exists and none is added.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->USD 0.1499 (USD/CNY 6.6712, Yahoo CNY=X, 2026-11-13). Per-ADS values are computed in CNY and converted at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic values are USD per ADS, comparable to current_price. Parity check on the dual listing: 2015.HK HK$44.52 x 2 shares per ADS / 7.8455 (Yahoo HKD=X) = US$11.35 against the Nasdaq close in current_price, a 2.5% gap consistent with the HK session closing before the US one; it confirms the 1 ADS = 2 Class A shares ratio and the rate direction. refresh_price does not move fx_rate - refresh both together.
inputs.ads_ratio: 1 ADS = 2 Class A ordinary shares (Q2 2026 release footnote; unchanged since IPO)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10-year government bond ~1.8% + beta ~1.3 x China equity risk premium ~6.7% (mature-market ERP plus country premium) = ~10.5%. Capital structure is effectively all-equity (debt RMB7.2bn against RMB86bn cash), so cost of equity is the WACC. The same rate is used in all three scenarios: price-war, BEV-execution and VIE risk are carried in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not in a stacked premium. Terminal growth 2.5% (CNY inflation is low; nominal premium-auto growth) and a 12x terminal cap for a cyclical, thin-margin automaker.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. Li Auto files US GAAP: operating lease cost (RMB7.2bn of operating lease liabilities) is already inside operating expenses and therefore inside the EBITDA margin path, so lease_cost_pct_path is zero and operating lease liabilities are EXCLUDED from net debt. The small finance lease liability (RMB349m) is deducted once in the equity bridge.
inputs.nci_treatment: Noncontrolling interests are immaterial (RMB533m book, -RMB1m of Q2 2026 loss). Flows are consolidated; NCI is deducted once at book in the equity bridge.
inputs.cash_composition: Company-defined cash position RMB87.5bn at 2026-06-30 = cash and equivalents 40,117.8 + restricted cash 14.8 + time deposits and short-term investments 45,474.3 + ~1,893 of long-term time deposits / financial instruments inside long-term investments (2,977.0 total). Less ~RMB1,350m estimated buyback spend between 2026-06-30 and 2026-08-26 (program total US$631.5m to 26 Aug less ~US$419m in Q2 and a small Q1 amount), so cash and the share count are on the same post-buyback basis. Debt = short-term borrowings 286.2 + long-term borrowings 6,864.0 (includes the residual US$145.7m 2028 convertible).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (CNY flows, USD ADS quote, US GAAP leases, immaterial NCI). Li Auto is an ordinary operating company (automaker), so the owner-FCF engine applies; no prior valuation or memory entry exists - this is a fresh build. YEAR 1 IS FY2026, of which H1 is already reported and already inside the 2026-06-30 balance sheet: H1 2026 reported FCF was -RMB8,689m (OCF -6,076m, capex -2,613m), i.e. about -RMB9.9bn on the model's owner basis (ex RMB849m interest income, after RMB375m SBC). Counting the full-year FY2026 flow AND the post-H1 cash would deduct that burn twice, so the equity bridge adds back RMB7,150m (PV), sized so the base case's implied H2 2026 owner flow is about -RMB1.2bn. INTEREST INCOME (RMB1.9bn FY2025) is stripped from the flows because net cash is added in the bridge. BUYBACKS: none FY2020-FY2025; US$631.5m (~RMB4.3bn, the buyback_cash figure, 2026 YTD) spent under the US$1.0bn March 2026 program by 2026-08-26, so the flat share count is now being funded. FY0 (FY2025) revenue RMB112.3bn is a trough-ish year, not a peak: FY2023 (net income RMB11.8bn, RMB44bn FCF on a RMB32bn payables inflow) is the peak and is NOT used as the margin anchor - base-case mature GAAP operating margin is ~3% against 6.0% in FY2023 and 4.9% in FY2024. EBITDA margin path is PRE-SBC (GAAP operating income + D&A + SBC): FY2023 9.4%, FY2024 8.8%, FY2025 4.8%, H1 2026 about -5%. WORKING CAPITAL: the business runs on supplier float (trade and notes payable RMB38.8bn against inventories RMB8.3bn and receivables RMB0.2bn), so growth releases cash and shrinkage consumes it (payables +31.8bn in FY2023, -13.0bn in FY2025); wc_capture is positive and deliberately below the historical ~40% of revenue change. Roughly half of the cash pile is funded by that float - see key risks. VINTAGE: Q3 2026 results are due 2026-11-25; the balance sheet, share count and FY2026 year-1 drivers should be refreshed then. Price is a regular-session close, not an after-hours print.

bear.margin_note: Never returns to GAAP operating profit (mature operating margin about -0.3%); terminal owner FCF is roughly zero, so this scenario is worth approximately net cash less the cumulative burn and supplier-float unwind.
bear.wc_note: 35% capture on a shrinking revenue base models the supplier float running off (FY2025: payables fell RMB13.0bn on a RMB32bn revenue decline, ~40%).

base.growth_note: Year 1 = FY2026: H1 actual RMB48.65bn + Q3 guidance RMB26.6-28.0bn (deliveries landed at 99,964, top of range) + a Q4 near Q4 2025's RMB28.8bn = ~RMB105bn. Revenue regains the FY2024 level (RMB144bn) only around FY2030.
base.margin_note: Pre-SBC EBITDA margin. Implied GAAP operating margin: FY2026 about -7.3%, FY2027 -2.3%, FY2028 +0.5%, maturing at 3.0% - half the FY2023 peak (6.0%) and in line with a consolidated, still-competitive China auto industry.
base.tax_note: Cash tax is zero while operating losses and the resulting NOLs are used, then ramps to 20% (15% HNTE subsidiaries blended with the 25% statutory rate and dividend withholding). The engine never credits tax on a loss.

bull.margin_note: Mature GAAP operating margin 5.5%, the FY2023-FY2024 average - a return to demonstrated profitability, not beyond it.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved off the 15/50/35 house default. Bear raised to 30%: the thesis rests on an unproven EREV-to-BEV pivot (MEGA recall, weak i8), the company is currently loss-making with H1 2026 gross margin of 8-11%, the price war has no visible floor, and the VIE/ADR structure is an unmodelled tail. Base held at 50%: Q3 2026 deliveries returned to growth and management guides to sequential margin improvement, but only a partial recovery is assumed. Bull cut to 20%: it needs BEV demand, industry pricing discipline and overseas expansion to all work, and rivals (Leapmotor, XPeng, NIO, Xiaomi) have been out-growing Li Auto for two years.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
